purpose: Compare current application v3 and v2 without tuning or changing either player.

common.opening: random legal moves; same opening and per-ply seeds for each colour-swapped pair
common.cappedGames: report explicitly; do not turn into losses, wins or draws

secondary.role: fixed-visits CPU diagnostic; not equal time or equal node counts

order: short functionality preflight on separate seed
primary with no concurrent compute job
execution.stopRule: complete declared counts; do not add games based on results
execution.python: use uv if Python is needed
execution.archive: hash settings, source patch, binaries/model identifiers, reports and exact command records in a new experiment; preserve older studies

interpretation: Primary answers how the current application configurations compare on this device. v2 has no deadline or deeper-than-4 interface, so no equal-compute-time claim. Six boards and sampled openings do not establish a human rank or strength on other devices.
